narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Ziz continues to talk in a hushed tone.>I'm not about to give you the whole spiel about how I got into this position, but here's some advice for you.Sometimes, all you gotta do to impress your new boss is take credit for someone else's work. So you're going to hand over the elixir, and I am gonna talk about how much blood, sweat, and tears I poured into making it.It's a new gig, okay? I need to make a good first impression!
narrative.requestItemsText: Are you here about...<Ziz looks around his tiny hut suspiciously, and lowers his voice.>The elixir?
